faults.name: Drop one copy
faults.question: With one replica or fragment gone, does the object still read — and who rebuilds it, how fast?

faults.name: Corrupt one copy
faults.question: The name and size are untouched and only the bytes are wrong. Does the cluster notice?

faults.name: Strip the durability marker
faults.question: Without its durability marker, does that fragment still count?

faults.name: Restamp a copy into the past
faults.question: An older-timestamped copy reappears. Does it win, or get cleaned up?
